newsitem.title: USA: Sprint rolls out PCS in Pittsburgh, Albany.
newsitem.headline: Sprint rolls out PCS in Pittsburgh, Albany.

text.p: Sprint PCS said on Monday it launched its personal communications services (PCS) wireless network in Albany and Syracuse, N.Y. and Pittsburgh, Penn.
Sprint PCS is a partnership of Sprint Corp, Tele-Communications Inc, Cox Communications and Comcast Corp.
The partnership and affiliates have licenses to provide PCS service in 33 major trading areas with a total population of 190 million.
Sprint PCS said it now served eight U.S. cities.
"We're in the process of building the country's first nationwide 100 percent digital PCS wireless network," Andrew Sukawaty, chief executive officer of Sprint PCS, said.
